gbm_population_evidence.quote: A Phase 1, Open-label, Nonrandomized Study to Investigate the Mass Balance Recovery and Metabolic Profile of 14C-bemcentinib Following Single Oral Administration in Healthy Male Subjects
Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer; Metastatic Melanoma; Acute Myeloid Leukemia; Myelodysplastic Syndromes; Metastatic Pancreatic Cancer; Glioblastoma; Malignant Mesothelioma; COVID-19
In good health, determined by no clinically significant findings from medical history, vital signs measurements, and clinical laboratory evaluations

gbm_population_flag.reason: Glioblastoma is named in conditions, but only healthy male volunteers are eligible; coded not_glioblastoma.

candidate_evidence.quote: Bemcentinib (other names: BGB324): Each 200 mg dose contains approximately 32.8 μCi (1.21 MBq) of 14C-bemcentinib and is administered as a single dose on Day 1 of the study.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: This was a Phase 1, open-label, nonrandomized, single oral dose study in up to 8 healthy male subjects (with 6 required to complete the study).

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Plasma samples will be obtained in order to evaluate defined plasma pharmacokinetic parameters for 14C-bemcentinib.

role_evidence.quote: This is the only treatment arm in this study. Up to 8 participants will receive a single oral dose of 200 mg containing approximately 32.8 μCi (1.21 MBq) of 14C-bemcentinib, 30 minutes after starting a standard high-fat breakfast.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational AXL kinase inhibitor (BGB324); 14C-labelled at tracer level for mass-balance study
arms: Single Dose Cohort - 200 mg containing approximately 32.8 μCi (1.21 MBq) of 14C-bemcentinib

coder_notes: Healthy-volunteer mass-balance/ADME study; the conditions field lists the sponsor's development indications including glioblastoma, but no patients are enrolled, so not_glioblastoma (flagged). Bemcentinib is the sole investigational agent (coded experimental_monotherapy for completeness), though there is no antitumour intent. The 14C label is a tracer for mass balance, not a radiopharmaceutical therapy, so radiopharmaceutical false. PK is plasma/whole blood/excreta only. Treatment setting not applicable (healthy subjects), coded unclear.
